Added 502 sites with pull-ins, showers/laundry/wifi, year-round season, online booking link; kept the $147 lakefront high from the 2026-10-11 read (lakefront types not offered for these dates today). Dropped the note's Campendium camper-reported rate (operator rates now recorded). Not stated: max rig length, a weekend minimum (the 'Single night midweek' wording suggests one but none is posted).
flags: RV age rule: 'Guests with RVs greater than 10 years old of age must be pre-approved by management' (resort policies). Family-proximity exception applies, so no price gate; long-stay check passes (single midweek nights sold online).
